Titus Mbathi retired from the ARM Board of
Directors in 2010, and graciously agreed
continue his association with the Company as
Chairman of the Rhino Cement Foundation.
“Establishing the Rhino Cement Foundation funded
from the after tax profits of the Company, and
contribution from Company employees, was indeed
a noble idea – we will carry the legacy of Mzee
Paunrana and ensure that we work to increase the
wealth of the communities we work in, the country
and its people.”
